title: Phenomenal experience- must see!
text: Me and my sister took the trip and we were blown away with how excellent it was! Great organisation, clear instructions to meeting points and an excellent tour guide Miguel. The boat trip itself was amazing - we saw so many dolphins and were told many facts about the dolphins in Gibraltar. Would highly recommend!
